SPDX license-header examples

Use the comment syntax supported by the source file. Replace `<YEAR>` and
`<OWNER>` with the approved copyright owner, and replace `MIT` when the project
uses another license. The header must match the repository `LICENSE` and legal
policy; it does not replace the full license file.

Shell, Python, YAML, Makefile:

# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) <YEAR> <OWNER>
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Java, C#, and similar languages:

// SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) <YEAR> <OWNER>
// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

HTML, XML, and other markup:

<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright (c) <YEAR> <OWNER> -->
<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT -->
